description:
Upload an encryption keypair for an approval channel. The server validates the RSA-4096 public key and computes the key ID. Note: the encrypted_private_key is already encrypted client-side with the user's password — the server never sees the password. The owner sets that password in the dashboard under Settings → Approvals password (https://proof.holdings/dev).

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

backup_dek_iv.description: v2 envelope: the IV of the recovery wrapping

backup_dek_tag.description: v2 envelope: the GCM tag of the recovery wrapping

backup_wrapped_dek.description: v2 envelope: the data key wrapped under the recovery code

dek_iv.description: v2 envelope: the IV of that wrapping

dek_tag.description: v2 envelope: the GCM tag of that wrapping

wrapped_dek.description: v2 envelope: the data key wrapped under the master key

name: upload_approval_channel_keys
